Author: Anomek, Noir Yamato
Name: NoirMech
Punchline: AnoMech with an LPDU Party Synergy strat and a pause. Go to an inn and start practice.
Description: A modified version of AnoMech by Anomek (https://github.com/anomek/AnoMech) that adds an EU LPDU strat for TOP P2 Party Synergy and a pause for studying mechanics mid-run. Spawns fake party members and bosses client-side so you can practice raid mechanics without a full party. Disable AnoMech while using NoirMech. Source: https://github.com/NoirYamato/DalamudPlugins
Changelog: The plugin repository has moved. In /xlsettings > Experimental, replace the NoirMech repository URL with https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NoirYamato/DalamudPlugins/main/repo.json, save, then reinstall NoirMech from /xlplugins. No gameplay changes.
